turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello? Dadi? Can you hear me, it is Rohan speaking.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rohan? Beta, is that you? Your voice sounds so strange, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I had a bad accident here in Chennai and my phone screen is broken, that is why I am calling from a friend's mobile.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my god! Are you hurt? Where are you exactly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am okay but the police are here because the other driver is making a big scene about the damages.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police? Why didn't you call your father or your uncle?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please Mrs. Khan, do not tell Papa yet, he will be so angry and stressed. I just need to settle this quickly so I can go home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't understand, how can I help you from here?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need twenty five thousand rupees immediately for the settlement fee or they will take me to the station.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? That is a lot of money, let me check my passbook first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is no time for a passbook, Dadi! Just send it via UPI right now or I will be locked up.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, slow down, I am getting very confused. Let me call your mother first.
